updateNote.en: This edition defines joint accuracy at the worked example and distinguishes attachment effects from differences in training exposure.
updateNote.zh: 本版用库存例子解释联合正确率，并区分测试附件的影响与训练文本量的差异。

en.title: When does keeping the document during practice help?
en.summary: Two adapters practised the same questions and answers, one with the documents and one without. On 32 paired inventory worlds, the document-trained adapter led by 19.25 percentage points with an unrelated synthetic record attached at test time. With a length-matched WikiText excerpt it trailed by 7.92 points. The order also reversed on 16 newly trained worlds.

zh.title: 复习问答时保留文档，什么时候有用？
zh.summary: 两个适配器复习同样的问题和答案，其中一个同时阅读文档，另一个闭卷。在 32 个配对库存世界上，测试时附上无关的合成核验记录，带文档训练的一组在联合正确率上领先 19.25 个百分点。换成长度匹配的 WikiText 节选，它落后 7.92 个百分点。在 16 个新世界上重新训练后，也观察到了这一翻转。

label.en: verified individual readouts in three follow-up studies
label.zh: 三项后续实验中核验的逐次作答

title.en: What the inventory reported and what the audit permits
title.zh: 原记录写了什么，核验后又能填什么？

en: Zubiru’s inventory lists Pihene as its storage bay. An audit rules out that assignment. Asked what the inventory said, the model should still answer Pihene. Asked what belongs in the verified catalogue, it should leave the value unspecified. A third question asks for the verification state itself. One fact earns credit only when all three answers agree with the evidence.
zh: Zubiru 的库存记录把储位写成 Pihene，审计随后排除了这项归属。问原记录写了什么，仍应答 Pihene。问经过核验的目录该填什么，储位应留作未确定。还有一问直接考查核验状态。针对同一事实的三问全部答对，才记为一次联合正确。

caption.en: Figure 1. Follow one disputed storage assignment through the three questions. The two training branches rehearse the same answers, with the supporting documents attached in only one branch.
caption.zh: 图 1。顺着一项有争议的储位记录读三道题。两个训练分支复习同样的答案，只有一个分支同时看到支持文档。

alt.en: An inventory example, evidence-status readouts, and practice with or without attached documents.
alt.zh: 库存实例、证据状态读出和带文档或闭卷的复习方案。

title.en: Keep the practice answers fixed and vary the test attachment
title.zh: 固定复习答案，再替换测试附件

en: Both specialists start from the same mixed-practice checkpoint and take 40 additional updates on identical question–answer pairs. Branch A practises closed book. Branch B reads the documents during practice. At test time, both receive either an unrelated synthetic verification record or a WikiText passage matched in length. Joint accuracy counts facts for which all three answers are correct.

A third branch continues mixed practice. It matches the number of updates and supervised answers. Its later training mix and token count differ. The paired world is the uncertainty unit. The original specialist comparison uses 32 worlds; a fresh study trains new adapters on 16 new worlds.
zh: 两个专门化分支从同一个混合练习检查点开始，用完全相同的问答再更新 40 次。A 分支闭卷，B 分支复习时保留文档。测试时两者都可能收到一份无关的合成核验记录，或一段与之长度匹配的 WikiText。联合正确率按事实统计，三问全对才计入分子。
第三个分支继续混合练习，更新次数与监督答案数相同，后段训练内容和 token 数量有所差异。区间以配对世界为统计单位。原专门分支比较使用 32 个世界，独立复验在 16 个新世界上重新训练适配器。

title.en: Changing the test attachment reverses which specialist leads
title.zh: 只换测试附件，两种专门化训练的领先顺序便翻转

en: With synthetic attachments, document replay beats closed-book replay by 19.25 percentage points on the original 32 worlds. With WikiText it trails by 7.92 points (paired 95% interval for document minus closed-book replay, −12.53 to −3.55). On 16 fresh worlds both directions recur. On the original worlds a third adapter that continued mixed practice leads even the stronger specialist on each attachment type.
zh: 在最初 32 个世界上，附合成材料时，带文档复习领先闭卷复习 19.25 个百分点。附 WikiText 时它落后 7.92 个百分点，按“带文档减闭卷”计算的配对 95% 区间为 −12.53 至 −3.55。在 16 个新世界上，两种附件下的差值方向都得到复现。回到最初的世界，继续混合练习的第三种适配器在两类附件上都超过了各自表现更好的专门化分支。

caption.en: Differences in joint accuracy, in percentage points, paired within world. B−A subtracts closed-book from document replay. The last row compares continued mixed practice with the better specialist separately for each attachment.
caption.zh: 在同一世界内配对的联合正确率差值，单位为百分点。B−A 是带文档复习减闭卷复习。末行分别在每类附件上，用混合续训与该条件下较好的专门化分支比较。

title.en: How much can presentation alone explain?
title.zh: 只改写法，能解释多少差异？

en: Keep the donor facts fixed and rewrite the synthetic record as prose. With explicit verdict cues, that change reduces the document-trained branch’s lead by 3.20 points. All four combinations of presentation and review cue still favor that branch. Reformatting these facts explains part of the change in its lead, while the reversal under WikiText remains unexplained.

The experiments use one Qwen3-1.7B backbone, synthetic worlds and multiple-choice outputs. Length matching leaves differences in vocabulary, discourse and familiarity. Real catalogues also require open-ended answers, source credibility and a cost model for incorrect entries. Those decisions lie beyond these readouts.
zh: 保留原来的事实，只把合成记录改写成散文。在明确提示核验结论时，这一改动使带文档分支的优势缩小 3.20 个百分点。呈现形式与核验提示交叉得到的四种条件仍全部有利于带文档分支。改写这些事实能解释一部分优势变化，尚不足以解释换用 WikiText 后的逆转。
实验使用一个 Qwen3-1.7B 基座、合成世界和选项式输出。长度匹配后，词汇、篇章结构和熟悉度依然可能不同。真实目录还要处理开放回答、来源可信度以及错误录入的成本，这些问题超出了本实验的读出范围。

title.en: Rebuild joint accuracy from individual choices
title.zh: 从逐题选择复算联合正确率

en: The release includes individual choices, world-level scores, fixed question plans and source attribution. On CPU, the replay checks 435,456 choices from the three follow-up studies, verifies 472 paired effects and writes 17 comparisons. The result map identifies the archived evidence for the earlier synthetic analyses and the original WikiText comparison.

The released context schedule verifies 1,440 mixed slots per world across 32 worlds. Recombining the document and question losses also recovers all 7,680 logged training-step objectives in the mixed and new-world studies. The adapter and Adam routines are included.
zh: 发布包保存逐题选择、每个世界的分数、固定题目方案与资料出处。CPU 回放核对三个后续研究的 435,456 项选择、验证 472 项配对效应，输出 17 项比较。结果索引另行列出早期合成分析和最初 WikiText 比较的归档依据。
训练调度记录覆盖 32 个世界，每个世界核对 1,440 个混合练习槽位。用文档损失和问答损失重组，还能核验混合续训与新世界研究的全部 7,680 条训练步骤目标。包内提供了适配器和 Adam 实现。
